_comment: Seed list for the DoH/DoT lockdown feature (Block 16.HW-0719 A.2). Public DNS-over-HTTPS / DNS-over-TLS resolvers by country. Blocking TCP+UDP 443 to these IPs (and DoT 853 globally) forces browsers onto the system resolver our observer can see. Collected + web-verified 2026-07-19. This is the pre-fill; the list is user-editable at runtime. IPs marked as also serving a website on 443 (1.1.1.1, 9.9.9.9) block slightly more than DoH. Entries without a hostname have no confirmed encrypted-DNS endpoint but are popular ISP resolvers kept for completeness.
